Trump links French protests to Islam and mass migration

Former U.S. President Donald Trump has attributed the student protests in France to Islam and mass migration. This statement was made in the context of thousands of arrests during the unrest. Separately, an FBI whistleblower has alleged that Trump ordered investigations into L.A.-area immigration protesters.
